body: The Fire of Your Heart Must Burn Brightly Q: How can Ibe successful in renouncing my ignorance? A: The fire of your heart must burn brightly. That fire will give you all the energy, strength and presence of mind to bear with, understand and ultimately see through your own mind. That fire will be your meditation and in that fire your ignorance, which is all your wrong ideas, w i l l b u r n . 2 0 8
